status: DRAFT; frozen byte-for-byte by the guarded launcher before execution
scientific_status: retrospective paired source-device communication-feasibility experiment; not untouched prospective confirmation
primary_question: Can bidirectionally compressed federated learning fit a declared LoRaWAN communication budget while remaining equivalent to the identical dense federated learner?
claim_boundary: V39 tests simulated model-update communication and paired predictive retention. It does not claim a deployment-ready alarm, verified physical degradation onset, live-radio reliability, or federated superiority over local learning.

fixed_evidence.training_choice: V37 ADAM_LONG selected label-free from healthy reconstruction validation
fixed_evidence.historical_v4_role: context only; V4 weights, split, detector and results are not dependencies
fixed_evidence.v38_role: the failed calibration result remains a declared limitation and is not reused or rescued

cohort.ldm_upb_b01_to_b17: not opened in V39; a future separately frozen external confirmation

model.initial_model_delivery: pre-provisioned with firmware and excluded from recurring LoRaWAN round traffic

communication_arms.name: TOPK_INT8_K64_UPLINK_ONLY
communication_arms.role: V4-like uplink-only diagnostic; cannot establish end-to-end feasibility

codec_wire_format.int8_all: one float32 scale plus one signed byte per parameter
codec_wire_format.topk_float: one uint32/metadata word plus K uint16 indices and K float32 values
codec_wire_format.topk_int8: one float32 scale plus K uint16 indices and K signed int8 values; K is fixed by protocol
codec_wire_format.initial_model_exclusion: valid only when firmware provisioning is reported separately

ttn_community_policy.scope: community-network policy only; not applied to a private network

lorawan.gateway_downlink_accounting: the common global update is transmitted separately to every participating Class A client

raw_telemetry_model.encoding: declared 16-bit signed ADC sample, independent of the larger on-disk CSV/MAT representation
raw_telemetry_model.ferrara_e4_exception: not in source cohort; first 453 acquisitions hourly then five-minute cadence
raw_telemetry_model.daily_bytes_rule: channels times samples per channel times two bytes times 86400 divided by cadence

evaluation.pointwise_zones: verified commissioning guard is negative; failed-device operation <=50% life is negative and >=90% is positive; middle life excluded
evaluation.primary_performance_endpoint: paired macro-device AUPRC difference, TOPK_INT8_K64_BIDIRECTIONAL minus DENSE_FLOAT32
evaluation.equivalence_rule: the complete paired 95% interval must lie within both predeclared margins
evaluation.communication_primary: bidirectional application bytes, fragment count, LoRaWAN airtime, private-network rounds/day and TTN-community rounds/day
evaluation.no_claim_if: uplink-only compression is feasible but the bidirectional primary is not
